question: 37 years ago, Wayne Gretzky passed Gordie Howe's 1,850 points to become the NHL's all-time scoring leader. Howe needed 1,767 games to get there. How many did Gretzky need?
question_short: Gordie Howe needed 1,767 games to score 1,850 points. How many did Gretzky need?
answer_short: He passed Howe on Oct. 15, 1989, in Edmonton, with 53 seconds left.
answer_detail: Gretzky passed Howe on Oct. 15, 1989, in his 780th game. He did it against his old team in Edmonton.
